book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Diyon Tobabitaiso wana Yaomal
Sauga toto o Helodi, iya Galili wali tologugui, Yeisu wasana i hago,
inoke i baek wana totuwalali elal i ba, “Diyon Tobabitaiso tei, i lutem yaomal elana. Heiya te kaiwena wana gasisi i gan ge ginol yawiyawi i awaawaginol.”

He valila Helodi Helodiyas i oe alona hi alolon, Helodiyas iya Helodi talina Pilipi, lagona. Diyon i mimi baaba Helodi elana i ba i ola, “Nige bosowaina nu alolonan.” Baena, inoke Helodi wana totuwalali i patunal Diyon hi lib hi yowan ge hi teli dela.
Helodi nuwana ni tagapaaliga, yaa gamagalau i lovakunagil, kaiwena Diyon hi abulilek-an iya palopita etega.
Helodi wana lan ab elana, Helodiyas natuna meluyovana i sagasaga boda mataliyaa. Wana sagasaga Helodi i yaliyaya-an hot,
inoke i papasila i ba, “O sila nam, ebo hauna gun nu awanuni, nasi na pewa.”
Hinana i baek elana inoke iya i baek Helodi elana, i ba, “Diyon Tobabitaiso mwamwalina nu gotomwa, balomana nu loke mwaha elana, nu pwatanim ge nu pem eliyau na kite.”
Kin nuwana i nak, yaa i ba nihi ginol ni ola galok wana nuwatu, kaiwena iyaka i papasila bolo hi na pati o elana mataliyaa.
Inoke i ba Diyon mwamwalina hi gotomwa del elana.
Balomana hi loke mwahaa inoke hi pwatanim hi pek yova elana ge iya i pwatanik hinana elana.
Yaka Diyon wana tohago hi nem, tuwana hi ahe ge hi na hi teli salaiya, inoke hi nok hi na Yeisu wana wasa hi pek.
Yeisu Boda I Paanil
Yeisu wasa i hago inoke panuwa o i eguluwai, i heya wagaa ge hi na papaeliya ge nihi mimwaumwau. Gamagalau wana egon wasana hi hago, yaka wali panuwa hi eguluwagil ge aeliyaa hi tatauliulil.
Yeisu i gailau, inoke sauga boda i kitel, atena i lomwanagil ge wali tokasiyebwa i pwamolol.
Sauga panuwa i kokoyavi, wana tohago hi nem elana hi ba, “Panuwa ya ana bwaga i gan ge kelaubwa bulin ni gan. Boda u patunal nihi na awan elal ge aliya nihi pwapwamola.”
Analiya Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Bahi nihi eegon. Komiu aanan etegana nuku pek nihi an.”
Hi baek elana hi ba, “Beleid nimala panuna ge moti eluwa ya te i gan eliyama.”
Yaka i ba, “Ku pwatanim eliyau.”

Yaka abwe i ba gamagalau nihi misiyoan mwawin pwatanaa, yaka beleid nimala panuna ge moti eluwa i ahe, matana i lihin labulabumwa ge i ba mulolu Yehoba elana. Inoke beleid i pigebagebal-an, i pek wana tohago elal ge heliya abwe hi guyauan gamagalau elal.
Gamagalau gegewel hi anan tineliya i kiya, inoke wali an teli tohago hi abubun, ana egowa elulutega eluwa.
Bolo hi anan, bolau ali gewi tabam paib tausan, yaa evenakau ge wawayau ali gewi nige hi aahe.
Yeisu I Nawanawa Hoga Pwatanaa
Inoke Yeisu i ba wana tohago nihi gaiha wagaa nihi houwa nihi alupanet labi etega ge iya gamagalau ni patunal nihi egonan.
I patunal hi egonan i mowasi, inoke iya maisena i na i ha oyaa ge i awanun. Bulin i gan iya maisena i miminaa to,
he waga iyaka ana bwaga i gan panuwa elana, bagol waga i tagapagenagena-an nabiyan, kaiwena mana i yu pahanal.
Mweluluga kekeisi tili kilok ge sikis kilok ali hawawala, inoke Yeisu i nem eliyalil i nawaa hoga pwatanaa.
Wana tohago hi kite i nawanawa hoga pwatanaa inoke hi lovakun hi ba, “Gagayumwa!” Inoke hi loi ginebi ge wali lovakun.
Yaka etimwawa Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Atemiu ni matuwa! Nau te. Bahi lovakun!”
Pita i ba, “Babala, ebo tunahot owa, u ba na nawaa hoga pwatanaa ge na nowa elam.”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “U nem.” Inoke Pita i gailau i nawanawa hoga pwatanaa ni nok Yeisu elana.
Yaa sauga mana i kite, yaka i lovakun ge i telipuna lobek, inoke i yoga i ba, “Babala, u pwamwalau!”
Etimwawa Yeisu nimana i paelu ge i pihikan, yaka i ba, “Wam abulilek nige i bwabwata! Hauna kaiwena u nuwa lalabui?”
Sauga hi gaiha wagaa yaka mana i mwatomwa.
Inoke bolo hi miminaa wagaa hi kululu elana hi ba, “Tunahot, owa Yehoba Natuna.”
Hoga hi alupanet-an hi na hi tan panuwa Genesaleta.
Gamagalau Yeisu hi kite inoke hi atena iya to, yaka wasa hi palelu awanina gegewena elal ge tokasiyebwa gegewel hi pwatanim.
Yaka hi awanun elana tokasiyebwa ana kaliko buhuna ya nihi pibose, inoke bolo hi pibose, gegewel hi molu.
